symptom: theme round trip failed for members whose default variant is not V_DEFAULT (avatar, badge, switch)
correction: restore the member variant and size captured before the variant x size sweep

symptom: javac: ACC.ROLE_GROUPING does not exist in SWT
correction: use ACC.ROLE_GROUP (constant list read from the SWT jar ACC.class)

symptom: itemDamage: no damage for chip because item 0 was already SELECTED by the activation keys
correction: toggle SELECTED to the opposite of its current value, then restore

symptom: theme round trip failed for containers: the state sweep cleared OPEN bits that the sample had set
correction: sweep flips each bit and restores the captured value

symptom: plane check ignored the plane's current offset (closed toast sits off-edge)
correction: move relative to the current offset and restore it

symptom: D check passed by coincidence for TOKEN and failed for overlays: model damage from layout() was not drained before the item change
correction: drain model damage after the full paint; flip SELECTED; also bound the width

symptom: product bug: dirty.add(r) on an empty Rectangle(0,0,0,0) unions the origin, so every damage-only repaint re-rendered from (0,0) (overlays at the bottom-right exposed it)
correction: start the dirty region with setBounds(r) when empty, add() otherwise
